notes: TVA standard rate 18% (CGI art. 317, as amended by the Finance Law 2025, National Assembly text). The art. 308 exempt-products list in the same official text contains no chapter-71 or precious-metals item, so jewellery and bullion take 18%. Import duty HS 7108 null: no WAEMU CET line could be opened on an authority page. No dealer bar list found.

sources.name: Assemblée législative de transition (an.bf) - Finance Law 2025 amending the CGI
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: art. 317 fixes the TVA rate at 18% (the 10% reduced rate covers only approved hotel/restaurant services and domestic air transport); the amended art. 308 exemption list contains no gold or precious-metals item
sources.quote: Article 317 : Le taux de la TVA est fixé à 18%.
